title: Ye Qing's Betrayal
next_chapter_hook: Just as the two stood in a stalemate, an ink-black contract pattern suddenly appeared on Ye Qing's wrist—the Holy Sect's 'Soul-Devouring Seal', her time was running out.

text.content: Three breaths of dazzling light from Su Qingyao's fragment faded like an ebbing tide. Chen Ji stood still, brow furrowed—the light shared the same source as the Tianji Record, yet carried an entirely different fate imprint, like some kind of... warning. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind: 'Master, someone is observing this place.' Chen Ji didn't answer, merely directing his gaze toward the dark night sky outside the window. Observing? No, this aura was all too familiar. It was someone from the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion. And the only person who could lock onto this location with such precision was... he couldn't think of a second possibility.

Half an hour earlier, he had received Ye Qing's transmission: 'Three days later, the Withered Bone Ridge, the old place.' The tone was characteristically cold, as if they were merely ordinary exchanges of interest. But now that he thought about it, that 'punctual appointment' had come too deliberately. Chen Ji slowly clenched the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve, his knuckles whitening. He recalled the fleeting complexity in Ye Qing's eyes when they signed that agreement. He called it 'sincerity', but in hindsight, it was clearly 'guilt'. He never made trades without a way out, but this time, the stake was the trust he had handed over himself.

Withered Bone Ridge. Moonlight like frost, scattered over jagged white bones, a faint scent of decay permeating the air. Chen Ji stood atop a shattered tombstone, his robes fluttering in the night wind. In the distance, a black figure approached through the moonlight, each step carrying a sense of absolute resolve. 'You've come.' Ye Qing's voice was cold as freezing ice, but when she drew within ten feet, Chen Ji caught a flash of panic in her eyes. That wasn't the wariness of facing an enemy, but the心虚 of someone whose lies had been exposed. Chen Ji's lips curved slightly upward, but the smile didn't reach his eyes: 'What's wrong, surprised I haven't died yet?'

dialogue.content: What do you mean? Ye Qing's brow furrowed, demonic energy slightly stirring around her, 'I kindly invited you here, and this is how you speak?' Chen Ji remained motionless, quietly watching her. That gaze was too calm, too calm that it sent an inexplicable chill through Ye Qing's heart. He withdrew a jade slip from his sleeve and casually tossed it toward her: 'See for yourself.' The jade slip arced through the air, and Ye Qing instinctively caught it, her spiritual sense probing within—a detailed intelligence record of every message she'd transmitted to the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion over the past three months: Chen Ji's whereabouts, fluctuations in his cultivation, even every interaction with Su Qingyao. Each word was like a sharp blade, piercing her heart.

Chen's voice was soft, soft as if narrating something unrelated to himself: 'Three months, seventeen transmissions. Each one sent within an hour of me leaving the Tianqing Sect.' He paused, a mocking curve forming at the corner of his mouth, 'Ye Holy Maiden, you truly are meticulous, even remembering which day I went to the rear mountain to relieve myself.' Ye Qing's face instantly turned ashen. She opened her mouth, wanting to explain something, but facing Chen Ji's unruffled eyes, all words seemed stuck. Under the moonlight, her fingers trembled slightly as she clutched the jade slip tightly.

text.content: Looking at Ye Qing's pale face, Chen felt no satisfaction in his heart. He remembered when he first met this woman—she stood before the demonic army, eyes filled with pride that overlooked the world. How spirited she was back then, but now... her shoulders slumped slightly, the pride in her eyes completely dissipated, replaced by a bone-deep exhaustion. Chen suddenly realized something: Ye Qing was the Holy Maiden of the Demonic Path, every action of hers was certainly under the Holy Sect's surveillance. Her transmissions to the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion might not have been out of betrayal, but with other bitter circumstances. But this thought only flickered briefly. He recalled the endless details in that intelligence, and the last trace of wavering in his heart also dissipated. Bitter circumstances? Who would understand his?

dialogue.content: Ye Qing finally spoke, her voice hoarse like sandpaper scraping: 'Do you think I wanted this?' She abruptly raised her head, eyes reddened, yet stubbornly refusing to let tears fall, 'Do you think I didn't know that if we were discovered, both of us would die without a burial site?' Chen stared coldly at her, saying nothing. Ye Qing gave a bitter laugh: 'There's an additional clause in the agreement, do you remember?' She raised her hand, her sleeve falling back to reveal a faint black pattern on the inner wrist—the Holy Sect's 'Surveillance Seal', once the contractor showed the slightest sign of异动, the seal's owner would know immediately. 'Do you think that clause was to protect you? No, that was my escape route. As long as I continued transmitting your messages to the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion, the Holy Sect would consider me a obedient piece on their board. And you...' she paused, voice dropping, 'Only by staying within my reach could I warn you in advance before the Holy Sect made its move.'

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent. Moonlight bathed his face, casting flickering shadows. Ye Qing's words were like a blunt knife,来回拉扯 at his heart. He recalled Mo Xiansheng's欲言又止 expression when they signed the agreement, and that barely perceptible exhaustion in Ye Qing's eyes during each meeting. He had not failed to consider the oddities in this, but each time, he was deceived by that woman's coldproudly exterior, selectively ignoring those不合常理的 details. Now that the truth was laid bare, he discovered his anger was slowly receding, replaced by an indefinable complex emotion. He slowly spoke: 'So, you are telling me that for these three months, you have been using yourself as bait, deflecting the Holy Sect's attention for my sake?'

choice.prompt: Behind Ye Qing's 'betrayal' lay bitter circumstances protecting Chen Ji, but this self-appointed 'goodness' still left him with五味杂陈. Facing this former ally who had fought side by side, Chen needed to make a choice:

choices.description: Anger and Questioning: Regardless of the reason, deception is deception. He needed an explanation, and even more, an account.
choices.visible_cost: Possible loss of an important ally
choices.visible_reward: Forcing Ye Qing to reveal the complete truth

dialogue.content: Chen's eyes suddenly turned ice-cold: 'Protect me?' His voice was like a poisoned blade, 'When you transmitted messages to the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion, did you ever ask for my opinion?' He stepped toward Ye Qing, his aura rising sharply, 'You think you're protecting me, but have you considered what happens if I die because of your 'protection'?' Ye Qing was forced back two steps by his momentum, lips trembling slightly: 'I...' 'You what?' Chen coldly laughed, 'You think you're clever? You think the Holy Sect are all fools?' He raised his hand, pointing at the black mark on Ye Qing's wrist, 'Surveillance Seal, hmph, you think this seal only monitors you? Wrong! It equally tracks every person you have contact with. In other words—you are not protecting me, you are marking me as the Holy Sect's prey!'

choices.description: Rational Thinking: His anger was receding, replaced bycalm的calculating. This was not the time for emotional impulses; what he needed was the complete picture of the situation.
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing might be hiding more

text.content: Chen took a deep breath, forcing himself tocalm下来. His gaze fell on the Surveillance Seal on Ye Qing's wrist, his mind racing rapidly. The seal could track contacts... what did this mean? It meant his current whereabouts were likely already exposed under the Holy Sect's surveillance. But strangely, if the Holy Sect had truly discovered the anomaly, given their usual style of operation, they would not simply conduct simple surveillance—they would act directly. So, who were these messages Ye Qing transmitted actually for? For the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion? For the Holy Sect? Or... a smokescreen for himself to see? Chen suddenly raised his head, gaze burning as he stared at Ye Qing: 'In the messages you transmitted, were any of them encrypted?'

choices.description: Letting down guard: Whether everything she said was true or false was not the issue now. What he needed were allies, not enemies.
choices.visible_reward: Ye Qing's favorability increased significantly, may unlock hidden plot
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing's attitude changed too quickly, there may be a trap

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji remained silent for a long while, then suddenly let out a light laugh. That laugh sounded particularly abrupt in the silent night, carrying a hint of self-mockery and a sense of relief. 'Forget it.' He shook his head, 'Ye Qing, do you know why I dislike cooperating with smart people?'

Ye Qing stared at him blankly, not understanding.

'Because you always overthink simple matters.' Chen Ji sighed, 'You want to protect me, I understand. You want to survive, I understand that too. Since everyone is struggling to survive in this chaotic world, why must we make things a life-and-death struggle?' He extended his hand, 'From now on, you don't need to pass false information to anyone. If the Holy Sect asks, just say we've broken apart.'

Ye Qing stood frozen, tears finally spilling from her eyes: 'You... aren't you afraid I'm lying to you?'

Chen Ji smiled: 'I am. But compared to being deceived by you, I'm more afraid of losing an ally willing to take risks for me.'

text.content: Three choices, three entirely different directions. No matter what Chen Ji decided, a complex light flickered in Ye Qing's eyes—relief mingled with gratitude, resolve coupled with desperation, and an indescribable sorrow. She slowly lifted her other sleeve, revealing a grotesque black scar on the inner side of her wrist. The scar spread like a spider's web from the center of the surveillance mark, nearly covering her entire arm. 'Do you see what this is?' Ye Qing's voice was soft, as gentle as a withering leaf about to fall, 'This is the backlash of the Heart-Devouring Seal. If I stop transmitting intelligence for more than seven days, this thing will devour my heart.'

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The Heart-Devouring Seal—one of the most cruel prohibitions of the Holy Sect, specifically used to control disobedient pieces. Those afflicted would die in extreme agony, their souls subsequently refined into puppets. He finally understood why Ye Qing had done all this—she couldn't stop even if she wanted to. 'So that's why you said as long as I'm within your sight, you can warn me before the Holy Sect makes a move.' Chen Ji's voice dropped, 'Because once they decide to act against me, you're the first to be sacrificed.'

Ye Qing gave a tragic smile: 'You've finally realized.' She raised her hand, the black scar gleaming with an eerie luminescence under the moonlight, 'To tell you the truth, three months ago when I discovered this mark had begun its backlash, I knew my days were numbered. Everything I've done isn't to protect you—' She paused, her voice suddenly becoming unnaturally calm, 'It's so that before I die, I can witness the day you personally overthrow the Holy Sect.'

text.content: The night wind rose abruptly, stirring countless fragments of withered bones. Chen Ji stood in place, gazing at this woman who had once been invincible, and suddenly noticed several subtle strands of white at her temples. The Demon Path's Holy Maiden, a once-in-ten-thousand-years genius, now resembled a moth trapped in a spider's web, struggling while awaiting death's arrival. He recalled what Mo Xiansheng once said: 'No chess player in this world is clean.' Now he deeply understood the meaning of those words. He thought he was playing chess, yet he never realized he too was a piece on someone else's board. And Ye Qing... perhaps had seen through all this even earlier than him. 'Is there a cure for the Heart-Devouring Seal?' Chen Ji suddenly spoke.

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing froze, clearly not expecting him to ask this question. She fell silent for a moment, a bitter smile forming on her lips: 'There is. But the price is too great, I cannot afford it.'

Chen Ji pressed further: 'What price?'

'The Holy Heart.' Ye Qing raised her head, her gaze landing on Chen Ji's chest. 'Legend has it the Holy Sect possesses a supreme treasure called the Holy Heart, containing the essence power of generations of Holy Lords. The Heart-Devouring Seal is originally a secondary prohibition of the Holy Heart—as long as one refines the Holy Heart, the seal's binding can be completely dismantled.' She paused, 'But the Holy Heart is stored in the deepest part of the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, guarded personally by three Grand Elders. With my current cultivation, entering would only mean death.'

Chen Ji fell silent. His mind raced rapidly, weighing various advantages and disadvantages. The Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, the Grand Elders, the Holy Heart... these pieces of information, when connected together, faintly outlined a thread leading toward truth. He suddenly recalled what Mo Xiansheng once said: 'The more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger the fate's deadly backlash.' If he could find the Holy Heart, could he also find a method to counter the Tianji Record's backlash?

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's situation was more dangerous than imagined, and the 'Holy Heart' information she revealed seemed to hide an even greater secret. Facing this former ally, Chen Ji decided:

choices.description: Since he chose to trust, he must see it through. He promised to help Ye Qing obtain the Holy Heart and break the Heart-Devouring Seal.
choices.visible_cost: May lead to full-scale war with the Holy Sect
choices.visible_reward: Ye Qing becomes a true friend through life and death, unlocking the prerequisite for 'Shared Destiny'
choices.risk_hint: Risk is extremely high, may affect overall strategy

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile carrying a hint of pride that surveyed the world: 'The Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, three Grand Elders?' He stood with hands behind his back, moonlight falling upon him, outlining a faint halo, 'It does sound terrifying. But don't forget, what Chen Ji does best in this life is turning those 'impossibilities' into 'possibilities'.'

Ye Qing stared at him blankly, her lips slightly trembling: 'You... you're mad?'

'Mad?' Chen Ji shook his head, 'I just don't like owing people favors. You've driven yourself to this state to protect me. This kindness, I've taken note of.' He reached out and gently grasped Ye Qing's icy fingers, 'I'll help you get the Holy Heart. But you must promise me one thing—before then, you are not allowed to die.'

Ye Qing's eyes instantly turned red, tears streaming down. She nodded vigorously, her voice choking: 'Alright... I promise you...'

choices.description: The matter is too suspicious, he needs more time to verify Ye Qing's words. Perhaps all of this is her scheme, perhaps there are hidden truths behind the scenes.
choices.visible_reward: Avoid being exploited, maintain strategic initiative

text.content: Chen Ji did not respond immediately. He released Ye Qing's hand, stepped back two paces, his gaze profound as an abyss. Ye Qing's words seemed reasonable, yet the more perfect and flawless an explanation appeared, the more it made him wary. Her timing was too convenient—appearing precisely after the anomaly with the fragment in Su Qingyao's hands; her circumstances too tragic—tragic enough to involuntarily stir sympathy; her request too tempting—the Holy Heart, a key item that could potentially change the entire war situation. Everything felt like a meticulously designed chess game, and he was being led step by step into it. 'Ye Qing.' Chen Ji's voice returned to calm, 'Everything you've said, I've taken note of. But right now, I need some time.' Ye Qing's eyes dimmed for an instant, then quickly returned to normal: 'I understand. If you don't believe me, I won't force it.'

On the Withered Bones Ridge, the two figures stretched long under the moonlight. In the end, Ye Qing left first; as her silhouette vanished into the night, the black scar on her wrist flickered with an eerie glow in the darkness. Chen Ji stood alone, watching her depart, his mind racing with calculations about the chess game ahead. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind: 'Master, do you truly intend to help her?' Chen Ji gave no answer, merely retrieving the Tianji Record Fragment from his sleeve, gently stroking the patterns upon it. The Tianji Record emitted a faint warmth, and a line of blurred characters appeared: 'The secret of the Holy Heart lies in...' The subsequent content was unclear, as if deliberately obscured by some force. Chen Ji frowned—the Tianji Record had never shown 'blurriness' before. He immediately realized this was related to his sister Chen Nian's situation. Any future concerning Chen Nian was a complete chaos. But one thing he could be certain of: the Holy Heart was absolutely worth his journey.

Just as Chen Ji prepared to leave, the communication jade talisman in his chest suddenly vibrated. His brow lifted as his divine sense probed within—a transmission from Su Qingyao: 'Chen Ji, where are you? Something big happened!' Urgent voices came through the jade talisman, 'Old Patriarch Ling Yuan has suddenly emerged from seclusion and specifically requested to see you. And...' She paused, her voice dropping lower, 'Three strangers followed behind him, judging by their attire... they appear to be from the Tianji Pavilion.' Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Tianji Pavilion people? They've found us so quickly? He looked toward where Ye Qing had departed, a complex light flickering in his eyes. That woman—is she truly trustworthy? Or is all of this within her calculations? Regardless, there was no turning back now. Since the Tianji Pavilion had made their move, they would never let things go. And Old Patriarch Ling Yuan... this old fox, what exactly is he scheming? Chen Ji put away the jade talisman, took a deep breath, and turned to sprint toward Tianqing Sect. The gears of destiny have begun to turn, and he stands at the storm's center.

dialogue.content: Just as Chen Ji was racing forward, Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly rang in his mind, carrying unprecedented gravity: 'Master, this old servant has something to tell you.' Chen Ji's brow furrowed: 'Speak.' Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, as if choosing his words carefully: 'That Ye Qing... what she said about the Heart-Devouring Seal is indeed true. But she didn't tell you the complete truth.' Chen Ji's footsteps paused: 'What do you mean?' Mo Xiansheng's voice dropped lower: 'The backlash date of the Heart-Devouring Seal can be artificially extended. It only requires...' He paused, 'Every seven days, offering a person's 'Heavenly Fate Value' as a sacrifice to the seal's master.' Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He recalled all the intelligence Ye Qing had transmitted—every piece was precise. If that intelligence wasn't only for the Tianji Pavilion to see, but also served as 'sacrifice' offered to the Holy Sect... then his three months of 'safety' was built upon how many people's sacrifices?

text.content: The night wind howled as Chen Ji's figure tore through the darkness like a black lightning bolt. Countless thoughts churned in his mind, each one sending chills down his spine. If everything Mo Xiansheng said was true, then Ye Qing's 'protection' was far more than simple deception—it was a sacrifice made with innocent lives as the cost. He thought of the grotesque black scar on Ye Qing's wrist, her red-rimmed eyes when she spoke those words. Was that woman a victim, or an executioner? Or perhaps both? He took a deep breath, forcing himself to remain calm. Now was not the time to pursue these questions. The Tianji Pavilion people had already arrived at Tianqing Sect, and Elder Ling Yuan was waiting for him. Whether Ye Qing's matter was true or false, the most urgent matter at hand was dealing with the immediate crisis. As for settling accounts with that woman... it could wait. In the distance, the outline of Tianqing Sect was already faintly visible. There, another breathtaking game of power awaited him.
